q: What is the delivery latency SLO and what exactly does it measure?
answer: p95 2 s over 5 minutes, from POST /deliver accepted to the first delivery attempt sent, not to the customer's answer; success rate 99.5% monthly

q: Сколько попыток доставки делает очередь до dead-letter и с какими задержками?
answer: 5 попыток, экспоненциально: 30 с, 2 мин, 10 мин, 30 мин, 2 ч; потом DLQ и алерт

q: Why does the hybrid IaC layout keep networking in Terraform?
answer: cross-account peering and DNS delegation need custom resources in CloudFormation but are native in the Terraform the network team already maintains; moving network was 30% of the effort

q: В gateway.md написано, что таймаут интеграции 10 секунд. Это актуально?
answer: нет; документ от 2026-03-18, таймаут менялся на 30 с (2026-05-18) и на 25 с (2026-08-24); текущее значение 25 с

q: Что на митингах называли «провижнд конкаренси» и почему без этого не проходит SLO?
answer: provisioned concurrency: прогретые инстансы Lambda на /deliver; без них p95 3.4 с при SLO 2 с, с ними 1.9 с (PoC-3)

q: What did the team mean by 'дрифт' and what rule came out of it?
answer: drift detection: stacks diverging from reality after manual console changes; after the 2026-02-23 incident manual prod changes were frozen and nightly DetectStackDrift runs with alerts

q: Why were gateway retries on /deliver turned off in August, when they had been turned on in June?
answer: June: retries enabled (max 3, budget 15%) once idempotency keys were mandatory; August: Lambda intake is asynchronous and a gateway retry enqueues twice, so retries moved to SQS with a DLQ (ADR-009) and gateway retries were turned off
